name: NorthWestern Energy
outlook:
What NorthWestern Energy says to expect

  • Full year 2026: non-GAAP earnings per shareWe are affirming our 2026 non-GAAP earnings guidance of $3.68 - $3.83 per diluted share.
  • Long term: diluted earnings per share growthWe are affirming our long-term diluted earnings per share growth guidance of 4% to 6%, based on our 2024 adjusted diluted non-GAAP EPS baseline of $3.40.
  • 2026 to 2030: capital investment planAdditionally, we are affirming our $3.2 billion capital investment plan for 2026-2030, which is expected to support rate base growth of 4% to 6% from our 2024 base year of approximately $5.4 billion.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
